observations.why: The verb 'switching' frames the move as adopting novelty — the appealed-to good is change itself, not yet justified by outcome.
Performance and cost claims appeal to achievement (winning on metrics) and mastery (capability of the system); both are asserted as goods in themselves.
The arrow notation frames migration as directional progress toward the new, appealing to novelty as the good.
Quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and capability as the good.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to stability and predictability — pinning the change to a fixed quarter is a conservation move within a change proposal.
